description: Negative controls for the KeyCortex parsed-command autonomy fail-closed correction. Each restores one defect in key-cortex-query-pipeline.service.ts and names the tests that must then fail. Run with scripts/proof-admission/negative-controls.mjs; the proof is a unit suite and needs no database.

controls.claim: The executable parsed-command set starts empty, so an authority check that throws leaves nothing executable. Restoring the historical initialization from parsedCommands makes every parsed command executable again on error.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01 an autonomy evaluation that throws leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01 a failure on a later command does not keep the approved prefix
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01 a genome autonomy check that throws leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P03 the conversational response completes with no effect when the authority check fails
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P06 the evidence and the log name a failed authority check as failed closed

controls.claim: The batch is atomic: commands approved before a failing evaluation are not kept. Publishing each approval as it is made keeps the approved prefix executable.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01 a failure on a later command does not keep the approved prefix
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P06 the evidence and the log name a failed authority check as failed closed

controls.claim: A verdict that is not an object with a boolean allowed is a failed authority check. Without that check a truthy non-boolean is read as an approval, and a verdict with no allowed is read as an ordinary denial that keeps the rest of the batch.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B a verdict whose allowed is truthy but not a boolean leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an unusable verdict (an object without allowed) leaves zero parsed commands executable

controls.claim: STEP_5_CHECK_AUTONOMY names a failed authority check as authority_check_failed_closed. Reporting it with the outcome of an ordinary evaluation hides the failure behind zero approvals.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P06 the evidence and the log name a failed authority check as failed closed
